issue.title: Fix bug in circuit-breaker check for geoshape grid aggregations

labels.name: :Analytics/Geo
labels.description: Indexing, search aggregations of geo points and shapes

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
There was a bug in the geoshape circuit-breaker check where the
hash values array was being allocated before its new size was
accounted for by the circuit breaker.

Fixes #57847.
